templates.text: 10-31, armed robbery in progress. Suspects are {Gang}, civilians on scene. Location's on your map, respond code 3.
10-34, assault in progress. A {Gang} crew is working someone over. Marker sent, get there before it turns into a homicide.
10-71, shots fired, multiple suspects. Witnesses ID them as {Gang}. Expect resistance. Location on your map.
All units: {Gang} and a rival crew are shooting it out in the street. You're closest. Let them thin each other out, then shut it down.

messages.text: NCPD Dispatch to V. Radio check, reading you five by five.
Dispatch copies, you're on duty. Stand by for calls.
Dispatch tried your line. Pick up next time, we'll call back shortly.
Heads up! Heavy incoming. They called in a hitter, watch yourself.
Scene's clear, good work. Payment transferred to your account.
Scene's clear and every suspect brought in alive. Brass noticed. Bonus transferred.
Paramedics report the civilians made it. That's the job, V. Bonus added.
Scene's clear, but we've got runners. Half pay. Tighten it up next time.
Disregard, another unit took the call. Response time matters, V.
You left an active scene. That goes in your file.
Congratulations, Senior Officer. Heavier calls are coming your way.
Sergeant's stripes, V. You'll have backup units on the big calls now.
Detective. Not bad for someone who started on patrol. Keep it up.
Lieutenant. The precinct is proud of you. Night City still needs you out there.
